newsitem.title: USA: Champion retains firm to raise holder value.
newsitem.headline: Champion retains firm to raise holder value.

text.p: Champion International Corp said Thursday it has instituted a number of changes and hired Marakon Associates in an effort to significantly increase shareholder value.

The company said Marakon will develop value improvement programs that will include an assessment of all the company's businesses and a review of Champion's markets, organizational structure and management processes.

The company said it is linking long-term executive compensation to achieving a goal of increasing total shareholder return -- stock price appreciation plus dividend yield -- to a value equal to 15 percent per year compounded for three years.

Additionally, the company said it is eliminating pensions for future directors, ending the accrual of pension benefits for incumbent directors and requiring key managers to attain designated levels of stock ownership. The company said it is also making a significant portion of directors' compensation payable in company stock units.
